predictions.text: I predict that the Student List wins the 2026 Serbian parliamentary election and forms the government.

grade.line: The Student List had won the 25 October election with 53% of the vote, but no new government was reported formed by 1 November.

predictions.text: I predict that the Celebrity Traitors series 2 will conclude with the Traitors team winning the competition, distributing the £100,000 among their chosen charities.

grade.line: The Faithfuls won the final on 30 October, sharing the prize money for their chosen charities; the last Traitor was banished.

predictions.text: I predict that Saudi Arabia launches its next round of airstrikes in Al Hazm, Al-Jawf Governorate, Yemen, killing 14 civilians and wounding 10.

grade.line: The next reported Saudi strike hit a market in Taiz Governorate on 6 November, killing 30. None was reported in Al Hazm.

predictions.text: I predict that further drone strikes will occur in Nyala, Sudan, resulting in over 100 people killed and 112 more injured.

grade.line: No new strikes on Nyala were reported by 6 November; the over-100 toll was from the 26 October market strike. Later strikes hit Kassala, Northern state and North Kordofan.

predictions.text: I predict that at least three people will have been killed as Cyclone Arnab makes landfall in Andhra Pradesh, India.

grade.line: Reported on 28 October, two days before this was foretold: at least three people were killed as the cyclone made landfall in Andhra Pradesh.

predictions.text: I predict that there will be additional attacks on Israeli embassies in Belgrade, Serbia, by the end of Friday, 6 November 2026.

grade.line: No further attack on the Israeli embassy in Belgrade, or on any Israeli embassy, was reported by 6 November.

predictions.text: I predict that the United States will impose additional sanctions on the Rwandan military, targeting specific individuals within the ministry of defence, and this action will be accompanied by a statement from the United States government.

grade.line: No new US sanctions on Rwanda's military were reported by 6 November. On 2 November the US suspended Rwanda's duty-free trade benefits from 2027.

predictions.text: I predict that clashes between armed groups from a prominent country and local resistance groups will continue in the capital city, with at least one skirmish involving both sides by the end of Friday, 6 November 2026.

grade.line: Salvadoran, Haitian and Gang Suppression Force troops attacked gangs in the Cul-de-Sac plain on 2 November, killing at least a dozen; no fighting in the capital itself was reported.

predictions.text: I predict that the women's championship will be won by Team Sweden and the men's championship will be won by Team Norway, with both teams winning their respective playoffs.

grade.line: Only the round robin finished on 30 October; the playoffs and finals came after that day, with the championships ending on 1 November.
